profile_text.body:
Dell Technologies is a public company, traded as DELL, founded in 1984 and headquartered in Round Rock, Texas. Its website presents it as a provider of technology solutions, services and support, selling laptops, touch screen PCs, desktops, servers, storage, monitors, gaming hardware and accessories.

The site highlights several product lines. It describes Copilot+ PCs as combining performance, built-in intelligence and all-day battery life, and points to the Dell 14 Plus. It markets Alienware systems with NVIDIA GeForce RTX 50 series graphics, and lists the Dell 14S and Dell 16S laptops. For business customers it promotes PowerEdge servers, describing them in terms of performance, security and scalability.

The company's profile records a CIK of 0001571996. A litigation exposure count of 125 is recorded for Texas. No product entries, lawsuits or MCP servers are held for the company.
